description: Create an incoming email from fields or raw MIME; fires email.inbound.

from.description: The sender, as an address or `Name <address>`.

raw.description: A whole message (RFC 5322); when set, the other fields are ignored.

to.description: The recipients, usually your app's inbound address.

webhook_endpoint_ids.description:
Send this action's webhooks to exactly these endpoints (IDs from
`GET /api/v1/webhooks/endpoints`) instead of the ones the rules pick; an empty list
sends none. Leave it out to let the rules decide.

webhook_requests.description:
Payloads edited for this action, by endpoint: each body is sent as written instead of
the rendered one. Leave it out to send the rendered payloads.

name: sendmock_email_inbound
